entities.summary: Cannae is an ancient village of the Apulia region of south east Italy. It is a frazione of the comune (municipality) of Barletta. Cannae was formerly a bishopric, and is a Latin Catholic titular see. Cannae is a archaeological site from Europe. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
